explanation.en:
一番 (いちばん) means “the most.” It is used to say something is the best, biggest, fastest, etc. It often appears in the pattern “X が 一番 + adjective.”

Key points:
• X が一番 + adjective = X is the most ...
• You can add a category: Noun の中で (among)
• Common with 好き (like), 大きい (big), 早い (fast)
• Useful for preferences

Example: “日本料理が一番好きです” means “I like Japanese food the most.” “この町が一番きれいです” means “This town is the cleanest.”

You can also say “A は B の中で一番〜です” to be more specific: “スポーツの中でサッカーが一番好きです.”

Practice by choosing your favorites: 食べ物、スポーツ、季節. Then use 一番 to say which you like most.

structure.pattern: (Category の中で) X が 一番 + Adjective

examples.japanese: 日本料理が一番好きです。
examples.romaji: Nihon ryouri ga ichiban suki desu.
examples.english: I like Japanese food the most.

examples.japanese: この町が一番きれいです。
examples.romaji: Kono machi ga ichiban kirei desu.

examples.japanese: 果物の中でりんごが一番好きです。
examples.romaji: Kudamono no naka de ringo ga ichiban suki desu.
examples.english: Among fruits, I like apples the most.

examples.japanese: クラスで田中さんが一番早いです。
examples.romaji: Kurasu de Tanaka-san ga ichiban hayai desu.
examples.english: In the class, Tanaka-san is the fastest.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 一番 without a comparison context
commonMistakes.correction: Include a group or clear context
commonMistakes.example: ❌ 一番好きです (no subject) → ✅ 日本料理が一番好きです

commonMistakes.mistake: Using を instead of が
commonMistakes.correction: Use が to mark what is the most
commonMistakes.example: ❌ りんごを一番好きです → ✅ りんごが一番好きです
